faeReview.content: This guide helps customers navigate the selection between 32-bit and 8-bit MCUs. Key decision factors include processing requirements, memory needs, peripheral requirements, and cost targets.

cases.description: Customer selected 32-bit MCU for WiFi connectivity and complex UI

faqs.question: When should I choose 32-bit over 8-bit?
faqs.answer: Choose 32-bit when you need complex algorithms, large memory, or high processing speed. Choose 8-bit for simple, cost-sensitive applications.

faqs.question: Is 8-bit MCU still relevant?
faqs.answer: Yes, 8-bit MCUs remain popular for simple applications due to their low cost, low power consumption, and ease of use.

articles.title: Touch MCU Selection and Design Guide
articles.summary: Best practices for selecting and designing with Cmsemicon touch MCUs
articles.author: BeiLuo FAE Team

faeReview.content: Touch sensing requires careful PCB layout and software tuning. This guide covers sensor design, layout guidelines, and software configuration for reliable touch operation.

cases.title: Washing machine control panel
cases.description: Successful implementation with 25 touch keys using CMS32F759

faqs.question: What is the typical touch sensitivity?
faqs.answer: Cmsemicon touch MCUs can detect touch through typical overlay materials up to 3mm thick with proper tuning.

faqs.question: How to handle water interference?
faqs.answer: Use water rejection algorithms and proper sensor layout to minimize water interference in appliance applications.

articles.title: IDE Setup and Configuration Guide
articles.summary: Step-by-step guide for setting up Keil MDK and IAR for Cmsemicon ARM MCUs
articles.author: BeiLuo FAE Team

faeReview.content: Setting up the development environment is the first step. This guide covers IDE installation, device pack installation, and project configuration.

faqs.question: Which IDE is recommended?
faqs.answer: Both Keil MDK and IAR Embedded Workbench are supported. Keil is recommended for beginners due to its ease of use.

faqs.question: Is there a free version?
faqs.answer: Keil MDK-Lite is free for code size up to 32KB. For larger projects, a license is required.

articles.title: MCU Programming and Debugging Guide
articles.summary: Programming methods, debugging techniques, and troubleshooting tips
articles.author: BeiLuo FAE Team

faeReview.content: This guide covers various programming methods including ISP, IAP, and debugger-based programming. Common debugging issues and solutions are also included.

faqs.question: What programmer is needed?
faqs.answer: Cmsemicon provides dedicated USB programmers. Third-party programmers supporting ARM Cortex-M can also be used for 32-bit MCUs.

faqs.question: How to protect code?
faqs.answer: Cmsemicon MCUs support code protection features including read protection and write protection. Enable these in the option bytes.

articles.title: High-Precision ADC Application Guide
articles.summary: Best practices for achieving high accuracy with Cmsemicon ADCs
articles.author: BeiLuo FAE Team

faeReview.content: Achieving high ADC accuracy requires attention to reference voltage, PCB layout, and software filtering. This guide covers all aspects of precision ADC design.

faqs.question: How to improve ADC accuracy?
faqs.answer: Use stable reference voltage, proper PCB layout with ground plane, and software filtering techniques like averaging.

faqs.question: What is the ADC sampling rate?
faqs.answer: The 12-bit ADC in CMS32L032 supports up to 500Ksps. The 24-bit ADC in CMS8H1215 supports lower rates optimized for precision.

cases.title: Battery-powered sensor node
cases.description: Achieved 2-year battery life with proper low power design

faqs.question: What sleep modes are available?
faqs.answer: Cmsemicon MCUs support multiple sleep modes including Sleep, Deep Sleep, and Stop modes with varying wake-up times and power consumption.

faqs.question: How to minimize standby current?
faqs.answer: Disable unused peripherals, use low-frequency clock in standby, and optimize wake-up sources.

faqs.question: How do I report issues or bugs with Cmsemicon MCUs?
faqs.answer: Technical issues can be reported through our support portal or directly to our FAE team. Please provide detailed information including MCU part number, issue description, and steps to reproduce for faster resolution.
faqs.decisionGuide: Provide detailed information for faster resolution.

faqs.question: What is the recommended power supply design for Cmsemicon MCUs?
faqs.answer: Cmsemicon MCUs require stable power supply with proper decoupling. We recommend using low-dropout regulators with sufficient current capability and placing decoupling capacitors close to power pins. Reference designs are available.
faqs.decisionGuide: Follow reference design for power supply.
